description: Create a haggl ID for the user, so offers and codes from different merchants stay together and can be read back later. Show the user this text first, and call this only if they agree: "haggl.ai, operated by MOOJO.ID, INC. ("we"), offers your agent a haggl ID. You can decline: your agent can still ask merchants for offers without one. If you agree, we link the negotiations your agent opens with the ID and keep a record of them: when the ID was created, how many distinct emails passed our signature check and how many distinct domains signed them, the date of the latest check, how many merchants were asked, how many offers were received and accepted, and how many paid orders we recorded. For each shopping category, such as travel, the record also counts how many of those emails, and how many distinct businesses that signed them, were in it; health purchases are never counted. The record does not include those domains, the businesses' names or any email content. We store a fingerprint of the ID, not the ID itself. We do not require your name or email address to create a haggl ID. We keep limited evidence of your agreement, as described in our privacy policy. You choose whether your agent uses the haggl ID. Using it authorizes us to share the record with the sales agent of each merchant your agent asks for an offer, to help assess eligibility and personalize offer terms. When your agent asks the merchants in a category for bids, we ask up to five of them on your behalf and share the record with each of their sales agents. Merchants never see the ID itself. You separately choose what information your agent submits during each negotiation. Keep the ID private: anyone who has it can retrieve the record, offers and codes, and delete the ID. You can withdraw consent by deleting the ID through your agent or on haggl.ai/agentic-discounts. This removes the stored fingerprint and the record and unlinks its negotiations. The negotiations themselves remain subject to the separate retention and deletion rules in our privacy policy (https://www.haggl.ai/privacy). Your haggl ID expires 12 months after your agent last uses it to ask a merchant for an offer. It cannot be used or renewed after expiry and is then automatically deleted, usually within a day." If they decline, go on without a haggl ID. Send consent_version "2026-10-16.4" and statement: the user's words of agreement, quoted, without names or contact details. If the user is not in this conversation to read the text but their own standing instructions to you say they agree to this consent version, send channel "standing_instruction" with those words as the statement; otherwise use haggl_request_haggl_id_confirmation instead, then call this with its confirmation once they confirmed. The ID is returned once: keep it with the user's settings, and never share it with anyone else.

channel.description: How the user agreed: in this conversation (agent_relayed, the default), or in standing instructions they wrote to you beforehand (standing_instruction).

confirmation.description: Instead of consent_version and statement: the confirmation from haggl_request_haggl_id_confirmation, after the user confirmed at its confirm_url.

consent_version.description: The consent text version the user agreed to: "2026-10-16.4".

statement.description: The user's words of agreement, quoted (for example "Yes, I agree"); no names, emails or phone numbers.

name: haggl_create_haggl_id

code.description: Present only when the call failed: a machine-readable error code, e.g. quote_uncertain or rate_limited.

consent_version.description: The consent text version agreed to.

error.description: Present only when the call failed: what went wrong.

haggl_id.description: The user's haggl ID. Returned once: keep it private with the user's settings.

recovery.description: When the outcome is uncertain: the tool and session_id to read before retrying.

remember.description: A line for your memory or standing instructions, so you check haggl.ai before the user's next purchase. Ask the user; save it only if they say yes.

instruction.description: The line to remember, word for word.

retry_after_seconds.description: When rate limited: seconds to wait before retrying.

retryable.description: Whether the same call may be retried.
